data.fund_type: An open ended medium term debt scheme investing in instruments such that the Macaulay duration of the portfolio is between 3 years and 4 years. A Relatively High interest rate risk and Relatively High Credit Risk (C-III)
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate reasonable income by investing in debt & money market securities such that the Macaulay duration of the portfolio is between 3 to 4 years. However there can be no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved. The Scheme does not guarantee / indicate any returns.
data.asset_allocation: (1) The Portfolio Macaulay duration would be between 3 years to 4 years: Debt Instruments (including securitised debt)*: 50-100% (Low to Medium) Money Market Instruments (including Triparty Repos on Government Securities or treasury bill & Repo): 0-50% (Low) Units issued by InvITs: 0-10% (Medium to High) (2) The Portfolio Macaulay duration under anticipated adverse situation is 1 year to 4 years: Debt Instruments (including securitised debt)*: 50-100% (Low to Medium) Money Market Instruments (including Triparty Repos on Government Securities or treasury bill & Repo): 0-50% (Low) Units issued by InvITs: 0-10% (Medium to High) *Debt securities will also include Securitised Debt, which may go up to 50% of the portfolio $ In terms of SEBI Circular No. HO/24/13/12(1)2025-IMD-POD-2/I/157/2025 dated November 28, 2025 and applicable regulatory guidelines, any existing investments held by the debt schemes in units of REITs as on December 31, 2025 shall be grandfathered.
data.benchmark: Nifty Medium Duration Debt Index A-III
data.exit_load: For subscriptions received w.e.f. October 1st, 2021 applicable Exit load: Redemption / Switch out within 12 months from the date of allotment – (i) NIL for upto 10% of the allotted Units (ii) 1.00 % for beyond 10% of the allotted Units.
